item.title: Django ORM Group By Strategies: Aggregation vs. Alternatives
item.description:
“Django ORM Group By Strategies: Aggregation vs. Alternatives”

When working with the Django Object-Relational Mapper (ORM), achieving the functionality of a SQL GROUP BY clause—especially when aggregation is involved or when you need distinct records based on a subset of fields—requires specific techniques. Relying solely on default ORM behavior often necessitates delving into advanced features or alternative approaches.

What are the idiomatic and robust ways to execute grouping logic within a Django QuerySet?

item.title: Best PHP ORM Options: Active Record vs DataMapper
item.description:
“Best PHP ORM Options: Active Record vs DataMapper”

When developing PHP applications, selecting the right Object-Relational Mapper (ORM) is crucial for efficient database interaction and clean code. ORMs abstract database operations, allowing developers to work with objects rather than raw SQL. This discussion highlights various ORM solutions, examining their approaches, particularly the distinction between Active Record and DataMapper patterns, and offering practical examples.

Exploring Prominent PHP ORM Frameworks

Several ORMs stand out for their capabilities and developer adoption. Understanding their core philosophies can guide your choice.
